1.consolidated_definition: Hormiga de color rojizo de pequeño tamaño, que vive generalmente en los cafetales, cuya picadura es muy irritante. Formicidae Wasmannia auropunctata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Red ant of reddish color and small size, commonly found in coffee plantations, whose sting is highly irritating. Family Formicidae, species Wasmannia auropunctata.
